name: Bullfrag
abilities: Long, sticky, prehensile tongue - grappling line, ranged strike, strong enough to smash crates and slow a falling skyscraper sign to a near standstill
Skilled melee combatant (took down Empress Attea and a squadron of Incurseans; held off a mob of Squid Monsters)
Enhanced strength (carried Bill Gacks while leaping) - far stronger than an average Incursean
Chest inflation to repel enemies and add jump momentum
Limited space survivability; respirators let him stay underwater four to seven hours
weaknesses: Very delicate nose - overwhelmed by strong smells such as a Methanosian's stench
Tongue hurts if stretched too far (Vreedlemania)
Needs an oxygen supply; in space he can only hold his breath
summary: A tall, buff Incursean in sunglasses and a black-and-green bodysuit - a Stallone-voiced brawler with a whip-like tongue, unlocked by Azmuth to infiltrate the frog invasion.
traits: Speaks with a Brooklyn accent; voice and mannerisms based on Sylvester Stallone
Sunglasses began as part of his disguise and were kept because the crew liked them
Empress Attea has a crush on him (and he finds her cute but not her personality)
One of only two aliens unlocked by typing a code into an Omnitrix (with Perk Upchuck)
Considered Ben's most handsome alien (Derrick J. Wyatt)
notableFeats: Infiltrated the Incursean war fleet in disguise and beat Empress Attea and her soldiers (The Frogs of War: Part 2)
Fought off Squid Monsters and saved Bill Gacks (Bengeance is Mine)
Caught the falling Billions Tower sign with his tongue to protect civilians (Vreedlemania)
Saved enslaved Benwood citizens from a falling drill machine with Mr. Monkey (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1)

appearances.designNotes: Taller, more muscular, paler and squarer-jawed than a normal Incursean; three-fingered hands, two-toed feet. Debut: black-and-purple Incursean uniform, helmet and purple sunglasses as a disguise. From Bengeance is Mine: green sunglasses, black bodysuit with a green centre stripe, fingerless gloves, toeless boots with green cuffs, green belt with white buckle; Omnitrix symbol on upper chest.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render of the standard (post-disguise) look, transparent but only 230x422; 'Bullfragov.png' (282x500) is the same art on a teal background. Action pose alt: 'Bullfrag Omniver new pose.png' (701x703). Disguise variants: 'Bullfrag uniform.png', 'Bullfrag helmet.png'.

scoring.rationale: A solid mid-tier brawler: beat Attea and a squad, shrugged off a Tetramand kick, and his tongue doubles as grapple and whip strong enough to arrest a falling skyscraper sign. Big jumps give decent mobility. No ranged or energy powers, a hypersensitive nose, and he needs air.

notes: Unlocked by Azmuth via a code entered off-screen (The Frogs of War: Part 2 first use is an off-screen activation). One of three aliens unlocked by Azmuth (with Way Big and Atomix).
Catfight: Ben was forcibly transformed into Bullfrag four times by Empress Attea's Omnitrix Remote Control (third and fourth were cameos).
Ben 10: Omniverse 2 gives a different unlock story (Ben scans a large Incursean) - game only, not canon.
